title: Schedule 1
description: A surprisingly expansive drug dealing simulator with wacky twists, involving growing weed, cooking meth, maintaining a customer base, dealing with rivals and cops, playable single-player or with up to three friends, borrowing from other simulator games.

title: Terry’s Other Games
description: A collection of games presented as an annotated bibliography, building on the developer's previous works like Super Hexagon, Dicey Dungeons, and VVVVVV.

title: Slime Heroes
description: A cute, approachable top-down isometric action game where a customizable slime blob fights corrupted enemies using light attacks, heavy attacks, jumping smashes, and spell-like skills to save a fantasy world from spreading corruption.

title: Knights in Tight Spaces
description: A deep strategy game with lots to unlock and explore, featuring battles on a tight grid where players position parties, avoid dangers, pick up loot, and engage in hand-to-hand combat, set in a medieval world of brawlers, wizards, necromancy, and conspiracies; successor to Fights in Tight Spaces.

title: Atomfall
description: Set in an imagined 1960s quarantine zone in the Lake District, England, after a nuclear plant disaster, involving stark mountains, creepy moorland, militarized towns with retrofuturistic mechs, and lawless druidic cultists; mixes influences like STALKER, Doctor Who, and Children of Men.

title: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
description: A chaotic, colorful multiplayer game pitting two crews of suburbanites against each other in houses with objectives like televisions, toilets, beds, and ovens; involves destroying enemy objectives, defending turf, barricading windows, setting traps, and pummeling enemies, styled like Rainbow Six Siege but with cartoon violence.

title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall
description: A sequel to Yes, Your Grace, focusing on morally ambiguous decisions in a royal household, securing legacy, keeping subjects satisfied, with narrative threads carrying over from the original and options to import choices.

title: TankHead
description: Centers on Whitaker, a digitized human consciousness in a drone body, controlling a modular light-armored tank to hunt haunted drone weapons (TankHeads) in an irradiated Event Containment Area to reach the floating city of Highpoint after a cataclysmic event.

title: Absolum
description: New roguelike beat-em-up with hand-drawn art style infused with a D&D feel, where you play as outcast heroes with distinct abilities to stop the Sun King Azra in the kingdom of Talamh.

title: Ball x Pit
description: Fast-paced fusion of bullet hell and roguelite with base-building, where you batter pits of monsters with magically-infused projectiles in increasingly challenging levels using randomized balls.

title: Mina the Hollower
description: Action-adventure with 8-bit visuals in Game Boy Color style, where you play as mouse-like character Mina who burrows underground, whips foes, and uses side arms to rescue a cursed island.

title: Goodnight Universe
description: First-person narrative adventure where you play as a six-month-old baby Isaac developing psychic powers, evading a tech corporation while seeking family acceptance.

title: Winter Burrow
description: Survival game with cute twist and Wind in the Willows inspirations, where you play as a mouse restoring a childhood burrow, gathering resources in cold environments, and crafting cozy items like pies and sweaters.

title: The Berlin Apartment
description: Narrative first-person adventure where you play as a handyman refurbishing an old Berlin apartment, uncovering its history through relics and past events.

title: MIO: Memories in Orbit
description: Metroidvania where you play as android Mio exploring the ruins of a vegetation-covered spaceship Vessel, discovering lost memories amid rogue AI machines.

title: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
description: Sequel to the 2022 critically acclaimed game, set in an immersive sci-fi setting with gorgeous art and excellent music.

title: While Waiting
description: A unique indie that tests patience, teaching players to embrace life's simple moments from birth to death, such as waiting for traffic, food to cook, or social media likes, with hidden Easter eggs and a gorgeous art style reminiscent of other narrative games.

title: Keep Driving
description: Players control a teenager with a car traveling across a map to a festival, picking up hitchhikers, working odd jobs, with roguelike events, capturing themes of teenage wanderlust and escapism.

title: Wanderstop
description: Players manage a tea shop in a magical forest as Alta, brewing beverages for customers, learning their stories, and growing ingredients, with a chilling narrative behind the shop; published by Annapurna Interactive.

title: Rooster
description: Follows the titular Rooster time-traveling to ancient China after a Lunar New Year dinner gone awry, combining elements of cooking, gorgeous artwork, and the Chinese Zodiac; debut console game from a mostly East Asian-Canadian women and nonbinary team.
